_comment: --punchout=no: drop the punchout package import and the whole /api/punchout/* route block (span from its section header to the next one, the /api/graphql proxy), and narrow the glue import to the few names the GraphQL proxy (magic-login settles a pending punchout session) and logout (clears the punchout cookies) still reference. Those resolve to the stub src/server/punchout.js this overlay ships, whose isPunchoutEnabled() is false. The glue import is anchored verbatim on purpose: a new name there means server.js grew a punchout dependency the stub may not cover. Alternatives: [0] = boilerplate after the 2026-11 security fixes, [1] = before (drop once the public mirror has the fixes).
